cause: pytest private temporary directories grant OWNER RIGHTS; Docker-created output ownership prevented Windows reads and left a stopped container occupying the fixed test slot
resolution: Fixture grants inheritable current-user access only to its own runtime root; bounded 90s wait with unchanged 60s tool budget
detail: pytest recreates private temporary-directory ACLs and removes inherited named-user access; fixture now grants current-user inheritance directly on its own runtime root before Docker writes
